answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 31512 Country: AF Title: Brazil Checken Question: In Afghanistan most of our people eat checken meet that come form Brazil in carton Hala is wrighten pl giude us is it Hala or Haram to eat jazakallah Answer ID: 31512 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 701/L=505/tl=1432) We have no knowledge about the chicken imported from Brazil that whether they parcel it after slaughtering it on Shariah pattern or not. Hence, we are sorry to have a say in the matter. If you have any doubt you should avoid eating chicken imported from there. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
